# Product Analytics Requirements Checklist: Product Activation Analytics

**Purpose**: Validate whether the 094 product activation analytics requirements
are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and ready for task generation.
**Created**: 2026-07-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements. It tests the requirements and planning
artifacts, not the future implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all public acquisition and product activation funnel steps documented with stable event names and ordered relationships? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Contract §parallel-measurement-matrix]
- [ ] CHK002 Are owner roles defined for every activation milestone, including desktop, auth/server, calendar policy, capture/server, cabinet, product analytics, growth, and ops? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract §dashboard-rollout-contract]
- [ ] CHK003 Are PostHog and Yandex responsibilities documented separately for every shared event/page class, including reason, allowed fields, identity rule, retention rule, dashboard owner, and QA evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012c, Spec §FR-021, Contract §parallel-measurement-matrix]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements present for all browser-rendered page classes named in the Yandex all-pages inventory, including auth callback, embedded desktop webview, admin, deletion, playback, and error pages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, Contract §yandex-all-pages-inventory]
- [ ] CHK005 Are retention/deletion requirements documented for attribution bridge records, PostHog events, replay recordings, Yandex Webvisor, offline conversions, delivery gaps, provider aggregates, and exported reports? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011a, Data Model §AnalyticsRetentionPolicy]
- [ ] CHK006 Are product telemetry gate requirements complete for first acceptance, scope changes, withdrawal, updated terms refusal, limited account/legal/export/deletion access, and direct desktop egress disclosure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-009b, Contract §telemetry-gate-contract]
- [ ] CHK007 Are provider-failure and delivery-gap requirements documented for blocked scripts, SDK/API errors, browser blocking, retry exhaustion, and unrecovered measurement loss? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016a, Data Model §AnalyticsDeliveryGap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is `first_value_session_completed` defined clearly enough to distinguish ready useful result view from recording completion, processing, failed, partial, empty, or auto-record states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003a, Data Model §ProductActivationEvent]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "stable server-issued pseudonymous user identity" specified clearly enough to prevent raw user/account/workspace IDs, emails, names, device names, and meeting identifiers from becoming provider identifiers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a, Contract §identity-attribution-contract]
- [ ] CHK010 Are "safe page views/events" and "replay-unavailable page class" defined clearly enough to separate page/event collection from replay/Webvisor/maps/forms collection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012e, Spec §FR-013, Data Model §PageClassAnalyticsPolicy]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the Yandex offline-conversion default subset unambiguous, including which product milestones are allowed and which remain blocked by default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012c1, Contract §parallel-measurement-matrix]
- [ ] CHK012 Are direct desktop provider-delivery requirements clear about when the route is allowed, what evidence is required, and when server-mediated delivery remains the fallback? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012c2, Spec §FR-024c, Research §Direct Desktop Egress]
- [ ] CHK013 Are "internal/support/smoke/test activity counted by default" requirements stated clearly enough to prevent accidental hidden filtering or unlabeled exclusions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Research §Internal Activity]
- [ ] CHK014 Are legal/campaign-readiness boundaries clear enough to prevent paid campaign launch or Yandex Direct optimization from being treated as part of this planning pass? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Contract §dashboard-rollout-contract]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Are spec, plan, research, data model, and contracts consistent that this feature is planning-only until separate implementation approval? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary, Research §Lane]
- [ ] CHK016 Are PostHog primary-workspace requirements consistent across funnel, dashboards, session replay, identity, and provider decision sections? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012a, Spec §SC-005a, Research §PostHog]
- [ ] CHK017 Are Yandex requirements consistent that Yandex is a parallel web/ad surface and not the product source of truth? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012b, Spec §FR-025, Contract §dashboard-rollout-contract]
- [ ] CHK018 Are replay requirements consistent across spec, research, data model, and replay masking contract that best-effort real-user replay is prohibited? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Research §Staged Replay, Contract §replay-masking-contract]
- [ ] CHK019 Are telemetry gate requirements consistent with withdrawal/refusal behavior and provider failure behavior, so accepted users can keep normal workflows during provider outage but withdrawn/refused users cannot keep normal product use? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-016a, Contract §telemetry-gate-contract]
- [ ] CHK020 Are `093` boundary requirements consistent across assumptions, plan, Yandex inventory, and rollout contract so public production analytics remains limited to `/` and `/download` until 094 implementation approval? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Summary, Contract §yandex-all-pages-inventory]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Are success criteria measurable enough to decide whether every proposed activation event has owner, surface, allowed fields, forbidden fields, consent/notice rule, identity rule, and deletion/reporting statement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK022 Are success criteria measurable enough to prove 0 forbidden private/content-bearing fields are approved in the event contract? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK023 Are success criteria objective about first-milestone deduplication by stable pseudonymous user identity across multiple devices or workspaces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001b, Spec §FR-003b]
- [ ] CHK024 Are rollout success criteria specific enough to evaluate legal review, telemetry gate, identity, provider configuration, dashboard access, QA evidence, and production smoke readiness before implementation or launch? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Contract §dashboard-rollout-contract]
- [ ] CHK025 Are replay-unavailable success criteria objectively testable as requirements, including disabled replay/Webvisor/click maps/scroll maps/form analytics and visible dashboard/evidence caveats? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006c, Contract §replay-masking-contract]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are primary funnel scenarios covered from public installer intent through first desktop open, account connection, auto-record enablement, first recording, first result viewed, and first value? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Contract §parallel-measurement-matrix]
- [ ] CHK027 Are alternate attribution scenarios covered for direct traffic, missing bridge token, unlinked desktop first open, multi-device use, and multiple workspaces? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §identity-attribution-contract]
- [ ] CHK028 Are exception scenarios covered for provider blocking, provider failure, consent withdrawal, updated terms refusal, failed processing, and no ready result? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-016, Contract §telemetry-gate-contract]
- [ ] CHK029 Are recovery or caveat requirements defined for analytics delivery loss without expanding collection beyond the approved contract? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016a, Data Model §AnalyticsDeliveryGap]
- [ ] CHK030 Are campaign interpretation scenarios covered so reports distinguish download intent, counted first open, campaign-linked first open, account connected, and first value? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005c, Contract §identity-attribution-contract]
- [ ] CHK031 Are dashboard scenarios covered for both PostHog source-of-truth analysis and Yandex web/ad/offline-conversion analysis without requiring manual exports? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-025, Contract §dashboard-rollout-contract]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for old/imported meetings viewed after analytics launch, so first value is not counted ambiguously? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003a]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements defined for page classes that have safe events but unsafe replay DOM, including how dashboards identify `replay_unavailable`? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013, Contract §replay-masking-contract]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for page classes where URL/title/referrer/event fields cannot be sanitized, including whether all provider collection is blocked? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012f, Contract §yandex-all-pages-inventory]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements defined for provider-held aggregate reports and exported dashboards after user/workspace deletion requests? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §AnalyticsRetentionPolicy]
- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements defined for internal/support/smoke/test traffic distorting conversion metrics while still being counted by default? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-006b]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK037 Are privacy requirements comprehensive enough across event payloads, identity, replay payloads, URLs, titles, referrers, session/user parameters, evidence, and dashboards? [Security/Privacy, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-012f, Contract §replay-masking-contract]
- [ ] CHK038 Are secret-discipline requirements documented for live provider IDs, API keys, cookies, client IDs, signed URLs, raw network payloads, and screenshots with real account data? [Security, Spec §Context From 093, Contract §dashboard-rollout-contract]
- [ ] CHK039 Are operational requirements documented for self-hosted PostHog hosting, scaling responsibility, egress, support limits, storage, and retention before implementation? [Operations, Research §PostHog, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK040 Are performance/resilience requirements stated so analytics never blocks normal product workflows and provider failure remains a measurement gap? [Resilience, Spec §FR-016a, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK041 Are compliance/legal requirements specified for product telemetry acceptance, legal review, personal-data/operator notice, Yandex terms/DPA, and campaign-readiness approval? [Compliance, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-017, Research §Research Sources]
- [ ] CHK042 Are production-runtime requirements defined beyond host `.env`, including composed config, live container env, rendered HTML/JS, provider reachability, and dashboard visibility? [Operations, Spec §FR-017a, Contract §dashboard-rollout-contract]

- [ ] CHK044 Are assumptions about self-hosted PostHog, Yandex all-pages expansion, legal copy updates, and campaign launch boundaries validated or marked as gates? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Provider Decisions]
- [ ] CHK045 Are future implementation dependencies on server, macOS desktop, cabinet, Docker runtime, provider setup, dashboards, and production smoke documented without turning this checklist into implementation testing? [Dependency, Plan §Project Structure, Plan §Validation Plan]
